svg.text: Political Research Monitor · from a world knowledge graph to a simulated public
Particles show which way data moves (motion is illustrative, not timing). Badges mark where each sponsor tool runs. Figures are for Mexico, November 2026.

g.text: kept only if the fetched page
Each polling agent interviews one simulated respondent in Spanish. Seed batch of 30 per storyline,
then 20 at a time. Built as a Modal .map() fleet; storyline-run-1 ran 96 interviews in parallel.
Each answer is stored in poll_responses: believes the claim (yes/no) and sentiment from −1 to +1.
fewer than 5 per stratum → next batch
LLM-generated personas, not measured Mexican public opinion: the explorer labels every result "Simulated respondents, not a real poll".

svg.text: One page per politician joins all four systems. Static exports on a Modal volume; no secrets in the public app.
Graph from A · claims and storylines from B · evidence from C (via past.dev) · simulated opinion from D, always labelled "simulated respondents, not a real poll".
SYSTEM C · EVIDENCE FROM THE WEB
Solid paths are implemented handoffs. Systems A, B and C also run as Modal jobs (make modal-systema / -systemb / -systemc). Figures come from the Neon database and the System D run, November 2026.
